Light Gray One-Bedroom Prefab House

The Light Gray One-Bedroom Prefab House is a purpose-built prefabricated modular home designed for residential living, resort accommodation, staff housing, and modular development projects. It features a white steel frame, light gray embossed metal wall panels, a pitched metal roof, and a covered front porch.

With overall external dimensions of approximately 8,010 × 6,010 mm, the prefab house has an external footprint of about 48.1 m². The reference layout includes a private bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, dining area, living room, and covered porch. Layouts, dimensions, insulation, doors, windows, and interior finishes can be customized according to project requirements.

Note: This product is a purpose-built prefab modular building, not a used shipping container converted into a house.

Product Type Light Gray One-Bedroom Prefab House

Final dimensions, internal usable area, steel details, insulation materials, wall and roof systems, floor construction, doors, windows, electrical systems, plumbing, and interior finishes are subject to the final project specification.

One-Bedroom Prefab House Floor Plan

This compact one-bedroom prefab house is designed to provide a simple and comfortable living experience. The bedroom is separated from the main living area, offering residents a quieter and more private space for rest.

The kitchen, dining area, and living room are integrated into a single open-concept space, making the interior feel brighter and more spacious than its footprint suggests. The bathroom is conveniently located between the bedroom and the living area. The covered front porch provides a pleasant space for morning coffee, outdoor relaxation, or a sheltered entrance.

The layout shown can serve as a practical reference for residences, vacation cabins, guest rooms, and employee housing. Room sizes, window placements, interior finishes, and the overall layout can all be customized to meet your project's specific needs.

Embossed Metal Panel Exterior and Steel Frame Construction

The exterior combines a white steel frame with light gray embossed metal wall panels. The embossed surface adds visual texture while maintaining a simple, contemporary appearance suitable for residential, hospitality, and accommodation projects.

A pitched metal roof gives the building a more house-like profile than a conventional flat-roof unit. Exterior colors, wall finishes, roof finishes, doors, windows, and porch details can be adjusted to match the project's architectural style.

The building is manufactured as a prefabricated modular structure. Its frame, wall panels, roof, openings, internal partitions, and service provisions are designed as part of one coordinated building system.

Custom Prefab House Design Options

This prefab house can be adapted to suit different site conditions, building uses, and architectural requirements.

- Layout: Bedroom position, bathroom arrangement, kitchen location, living space, storage, porch layout, and room proportions.
- Dimensions: Overall size, module arrangement, building length, width, and room configuration.
- Exterior: Panel color, wall finish, roof color, door style, window type, glazing, and porch treatment.
- Insulation: Wall, roof, floor, window, and door insulation options based on climate and performance requirements.
- Interior: Flooring, ceiling, wall finishes, cabinets, sanitary ware, lighting, and furniture configuration.
- Building Services: Electrical layout, socket locations, lighting, water supply, drainage, kitchen equipment, and bathroom fixtures.

Customization should be confirmed during the design stage to ensure the final building configuration meets the intended use, site conditions, transportation requirements, and applicable local regulations.

Suitable Applications for One-Bedroom Prefab Houses

The Light Gray One-Bedroom Prefab House can be adapted for a range of residential and accommodation projects. Its exterior finish, insulation level, interior layout, and building styles can be selected to match the intended use and local requirements.

Residential Homes

Suitable for small private homes, backyard dwellings, guest houses, and secondary residential units. Buyers can customize the exterior cladding, insulation, doors and windows, kitchen layout, and interior materials based on local climate conditions and their living preferences.

Vacation Cabins and Resort Accommodation

Well suited to holiday cabins, resort rooms, eco-lodges, and short-term rental accommodation. The exterior color scheme, porch design, glazing, interior finish, and furniture package can be coordinated to create a consistent guest experience across a hospitality project.

Worker and Staff Accommodation

Suitable for construction camps, industrial facilities, agricultural sites, mining projects, and remote work locations that require repeatable accommodation units. Multiple buildings can be specified with consistent dimensions and finishes, while insulation, electrical systems, and sanitary configurations can be adapted to the project location.

Rental and Modular Housing Developments

Suitable for small-scale rental housing, employee dormitories, or modular housing development projects. For multi-unit projects, the design can be standardized to ensure consistent production and a uniform appearance, while interior finishes, doors, windows, and equipment configurations can be adjusted as needed.

Why Choose NEW BRAND for Prefab Houses?

NEW BRAND supplies prefabricated modular houses for residential, accommodation, and multi-unit building projects. From compact single homes to repeatable housing units, each project can be tailored in layout, dimensions, exterior finish, insulation, doors and windows, and interior systems.

With a [Capacity to be supplied] m² manufacturing base and ISO 9001-certified quality management, NEW BRAND combines factory production with project-specific customization. The company has supported customers in more than 50 countries and can develop solutions for different climates, design preferences, and project requirements.

Every prefab house project has different requirements. Whether you need a single unit or a larger development, NEW BRAND can adapt the layout, materials, finishes, and building systems to suit the intended use, site conditions, local requirements, and required quantity.

Share your preferred dimensions, quantity, destination, intended use, and required specifications. NEW BRAND can recommend a suitable layout, exterior finish, insulation option, and interior configuration for your project.

Frequently Asked Questions

1
Can This Prefab House Meet Local Building Requirements?
Approval depends on local building codes, planning rules, site conditions, intended use, and the final specification. Before finalizing the design proposal, you should provide information about the project location and specific requirements regarding structural, energy-efficiency, electrical, or plumbing and drainage aspects.
2
What Site Information Is Needed for a Prefab House Project?
Please confirm the site location, ground conditions, foundation plan, local climate conditions, and water, drainage, and electrical connections. This information will help determine the appropriate modular building configuration.
3
Can This Prefab House Be Shipped Internationally?
Yes. Shipping arrangements depend on the building configuration, packing method, destination port, and local transport conditions. Port access, inland road restrictions, site access, unloading space, and any oversized-load permits should be checked before shipment.
4
What Foundation Does a Prefab House Require?
Foundation requirements depend on soil conditions, local regulations, the building design, and site conditions. Options may include a concrete slab, strip foundation, or piers.
5
Can NEW BRAND Supply Multiple Prefab Houses for One Project?
Yes. This model can be supplied for multi-unit accommodation, rental housing, resort, staff housing, or residential projects. Units can follow one standardized design, with selected finishes, insulation, openings, or service packages adjusted when required.
